texts:
Thursday night is in the books and Sunday's roles are getting clearer. Here is what moved since yesterday, team by team.

Emanuel Wilson is a drop.

Bhayshul Tuten has the Jacksonville backfield.

Marvin Harrison Jr. debuts in London.
#Seahawks #DUUUVAL #HTownMade

Emanuel Wilson ran 14 times for 52 in Seattle's 17-14 overtime loss @DEN, but he played 33 percent of the snaps and ran 9 routes.

RB59 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.
#Seahawks #BroncosCountry

George Holani played 56 percent of Seattle's snaps @DEN and ran 27 routes on Sam Darnold's 51 throws.

Zach Charbonnet sat a second game on PUP. RB47 rest of season for me. Hold him; the call changes if Seattle leaves him on PUP through Week 7.
#Seahawks

RJ Harvey got 4 targets and ran a route on 40 percent of the dropbacks vs SEA, after 1 target in Week 5. RB33 rest of season for me. Hold him.

J.K. Dobbins played 54 percent of the snaps and ran 17 times for 41 and a TD. RB36 rest of season for me.
#BroncosCountry

Jaylen Waddle drew 7 targets vs SEA, a 29 percent share, in a game where Bo Nix threw for 107 yards. He left briefly with the shoulder and came back.

WR15 rest of season for me. Hold him; the call changes if the shoulder costs him practice next week.
#BroncosCountry

Baker Mayfield is out vs PIT with the dislocated right thumb, and Jalon Daniels makes a third straight start. QB27 for me, outside my top 12.

Mayfield is QB24 rest of season. Monitor; next week's practice reports.
#GoBucs #HereWeGo

Pat Freiermuth caught 5 for 44 and 2 TDs vs IND, and Pittsburgh plays @TB without Michael Pittman Jr., Roman Wilson and Ben Skowronek.

TE13 for me, a streamer this week.
#HereWeGo #GoBucs

Bhayshul Tuten had 22 of Jacksonville's 24 running back carries in London in Week 5, on about two thirds of the snaps.

RB15 for me vs HOU, an RB2.
#DUUUVAL #HTownMade

Marvin Harrison Jr. debuts for Houston @JAX as the No. 2 outside receiver next to Nico Collins. He had 5 catches for 85 in four games with Arizona.

Off my Week 6 list, WR43 rest of season. Monitor; his route share Sunday at 9:30 AM ET.
#HTownMade #DUUUVAL

Jonathan Taylor played 71 and 73 percent of the snaps the last two weeks, down from 89 in Week 1, with Seth McGowan near 30 percent.

RB3 for me vs TEN this week. Hold him.
#ForTheShoe #TitanUp

Kendre Miller had all 4 of New Orleans' red-zone carries vs MIN while Alvin Kamara played 12 snaps with the back.

Kamara is questionable @NYG. Miller is RB32 for me, a low-end RB3 and a low-end flex play.
#Saints #NYGiants

MarShawn Lloyd scored twice on 10 carries vs CHI with 42 percent of Green Bay's running back touches. Josh Jacobs is on the Commissioner's Exempt List.

RB22 for me vs DAL this week, an RB2. RB41 rest of season.
#GoPackGo #DallasCowboys

Every note from today is on the Pass, and Sunday's inactives and pivots come next.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Sunday's calls, and like this if it helps your lineup.
